description: Keyword Tool brings free keyword research into ChatGPT with no sign-up, API key, or credit card. Turn a seed into up to 1,000 Google and Bing autocomplete ideas—including suggestions, questions, prepositions, and related keywords—then view available search volume, competition, and trend data for top results. Research 100+ countries and languages and check your free quota anytime.

defaultPrompt: Find long-tail keyword ideas for vegan protein powder on Google in the United States.
Give me question-style keywords for CRM software on Bing.
Check my guest Keyword Tool quota and remaining requests.
